               <lb n="19a8"/>gzhi'i tha snyad du ma yon pa'i mtshan gzhi la sgrub chos kyang yod rgyu rkyen las skyes pa dang suM pa lta bu | dgag chos kyang yod don byed nus pas stong ba dang stong nyid bzhin no zhe na | 'di rigs par ma mthong de ltar na mtshid la yang sgrub chos kyis ma khyab par 'gyur don byed nus pas stong ba laso pa dgag chos yod pa'i phyir | don byed pas stong ldog dang
               <lb n="19a9"/>don ldog chos 3 tshang ba zhes pa ldog pa tha dad do zhe na | 'dir yang don byed pas stong ldog dang mtshan mtshon czung 1 gi rten byed ldog dgag sgrub ldog pa tha dad do || </seg></TEI>
